patterns.note: The header containing the site logo and navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The initial hero section features numerous hand-drawn doodles that animate and float independently, creating a dynamic and playful visual effect.

Major page sections are delineated by dramatic, full-bleed background color changes, transitioning from white to dark green for the 'get in touch' section, and then to a vibrant yellow for the footer.
The site uses a striking contrast between oversized, bold, display-style headings and small, clean sans-serif text for body copy and navigation elements.
Content is presented in a mix of full-bleed imagery (like the collage) and structured grids for product showcases, maintaining a consistent visual rhythm despite varied content types.

technique_notes: The sticky header can be achieved by fixing its position to the top of the viewport, ensuring it remains visible throughout the scroll. The animated doodles in the hero section are likely implemented using CSS keyframe animations or a JavaScript library to control their position, scale, and opacity over time, giving them a floating, independent movement. Sectional background color changes are applied to full-width containers, with each container having a distinct background color that fills the viewport as it scrolls into view, creating clear visual breaks between content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy display headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual impact, contrasted with small, clean sans-serif for body and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero and between major sections, with a balanced density within content grids.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost rebellious use of color and playful, hand-drawn animated doodles that inject a strong sense of personality and artistic flair. The dramatic, full-page background color shifts between sections are a unique and effective way to delineate content and maintain visual interest, moving far beyond typical subtle section breaks.
